reports.text: FINAL DIAGNOSIS. A. Ovary, right, salpingo-oophorectomy: High grade serous carcinoma, FIGO grade 3. Tumor involves the ovarian surface. B. Ovary, left, salpingo-oophorectomy: Metastatic carcinoma. C. Omentum, omentectomy: Metastatic high grade serous carcinoma, largest deposit 4.5 cm. D. Uterus, hysterectomy: No tumor identified. E. Pelvic lymph nodes: Metastatic carcinoma in 2/11 lymph nodes. Lymphovascular invasion is present. Peritoneal washings: positive for malignant cells.

DIAGNOSIS. Left ovary: Papillary serous adenocarcinoma, poorly differentiated. Right ovary: benign, no tumor. Omentum: negative for malignancy. No lymphovascular invasion identified. Lymph nodes, para-aortic: 0/6 nodes. Washings: negative for malignant cells. Residual tumor less than 1 cm per operative note.
Specimen received in formalin. Gross description only; see addendum.
